import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Price distribution by brand (top 10 brands)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().head(10).index
brand_data = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)]
sns.boxplot(data=brand_data, x='brand', y='price_usd', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price Distribution by Top 10 Brands', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price with sensor type
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                     c=df['max_iso'], cmap='viridis', 
                     alpha=0.6, s=50, edgecolors='w', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price (colored by Max ISO)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Max ISO', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Body type distribution with 4K video capability
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
body_type_counts = df.groupby(['body_type', 'has_video_4k']).size().unstack()
body_type_counts.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, 
                     color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Camera Body Types with 4K Video Capability', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax3.legend(['No 4K', 'Has 4K'], title='4K Video', fontsize=9)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Price vs Weight by sensor type
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
sensor_types = df['sensor_type'].unique()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(sensor_types)))
for i, sensor in enumerate(sensor_types):
    sensor_data = df[df['sensor_type'] == sensor]
    ax4.scatter(sensor_data['weight_grams'], sensor_data['price_usd'], 
               color=colors[i], alpha=0.7, s=60, label=sensor, edgecolors='w', linewidth=0.5)
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Price vs Weight by Sensor Type', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax4.legend(title='Sensor Type', fontsize=9, title_fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Model year trends
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
year_stats = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'price_usd': 'mean',
    'megapixels': 'mean',
    'has_video_4k': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

ax5_twin = ax5.twinx()
line1 = ax5.plot(year_stats['model_year'], year_stats['price_usd'], 
                color='#FF6B6B', linewidth=2.5, marker='o', label='Avg Price')
line2 = ax5_twin.plot(year_stats['model_year'], year_stats['megapixels'], 
                     color='#4ECDC4', linewidth=2.5, marker='s', label='Avg Megapixels')

ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#FF6B6B')
ax5_twin.set_ylabel('Average Megapixels', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color='#4ECDC4')
ax5.set_title('Camera Specifications Trends by Model Year', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax5.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#FF6B6B')
ax5_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#4ECDC4')

lines = line1 + line2
labels = [l.get_label() for l in lines]
ax5.legend(lines, labels, loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Lens mount distribution with average price
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
lens_stats = df.groupby('lens_mount').agg({
    'price_usd': 'mean',
    'model_year': 'count'
}).sort_values('price_usd', ascending=False).head(8)

bars = ax6.bar(range(len(lens_stats)), lens_stats['price_usd'], 
              color=plt.cm.Paired(np.linspace(0, 1, len(lens_stats))))
ax6.set_xlabel('Lens Mount', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Top 8 Lens Mounts by Average Price', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=12)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(lens_stats)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(lens_stats.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# Add count labels on bars
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(lens_stats.iterrows()):
    count = int(row['model_year'])
    ax6.text(i, row['price_usd'] + 50, f'n={count}', 
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: Specifications and Pricing Insights', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
